query: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.artist, COUNT(v.id) as votes_count FROM songs s LEFT JOIN votes v ON s.id = v.songId GROUP BY s.id, s.title, s.artist ORDER BY votes_count DESC LIMIT 10;
